title: Views or instants: reproducibility archive for frame-budget allocation in multi-camera path-length measurement
description:
Reproducibility archive for the Measurement Science and Technology manuscript on allocating camera views and sampling instants under a frame-processing budget.

Version 1.0.4 adds eleven-grid sampling sensitivity, fixed spatial and temporal robustness controls, and retrospective development-only configuration selection. Across 17820 window configurations on previously examined records, unfiltered rankings depend on the sampling grid. Spatial checks give lower three-view error in all eleven grids at 84 and 168 frames, with all 60 evaluation windows complete. On the original 168-frame grid, rejecting two internal observations reduces three-view MAE from 85.66 to 7.92 mm. Additional temporal gating loses completed windows and does not consistently improve accuracy. These are retrospective analyses, not fresh independent validation. The historical subset score is correctly described as a best-pair score; original selected cameras, frozen protocols and sealed results are unchanged.

notes: The manuscript is prepared for submission and has not been finally submitted. Version 1.0.4 includes 17820 grid/processing configurations on five development and four evaluation records; grids reuse the same windows and are not independent replicates. All 240 overlapping uniform DLT predictions reproduce v1.0.3 exactly. New results are retrospective. Original frozen files and source snapshots are preserved. The reference-decimation range is reported directly rather than converted to an uncertainty. No third-party image datasets or model weights are redistributed.
